summary: Re-verified backend + frontend after real Bata SIS data reseed. Backend pytest suite updated for new expectations (10 partners incl. SHOPPERS/CENTRO/KORA/LIFESTYLE/LULU/INC5/RCENTRAL/RTRENDS/SPENCER/ZUUP, 15 reports incl. target_vs_actual/stock_position/partner_margin, dashboard as_of=2026-08-09 with weekly array + Week-32 target achievement). All 54 pytest cases pass. SHOPPERS auto-upload flow verified: partner auto-recognised via learned mapping, batch processed with 3 rows, then rejected for cleanup. Frontend verified via Playwright with admin login: dashboard renders KPI cards (dashboard-kpi-total-sales '₹97.88 L', dashboard-kpi-target '69.7%'), weekly recharts renders (6 svgs on dashboard), Reports page shows all 15 report tiles including target_vs_actual/stock_position/partner_margin, Target-vs-Actual drill-in shows 9 partner rows, Partner Configuration lists all 10 partners with v1 mapping versions, Ingestion Batches shows 16 batch rows + hero (16 batches / 1278 open exceptions), Insights page has 27 cards including 'Missing submission: SPENCER'.

issues: Only 1 data point rendered as a wide filled block; chart looks visually broken. Root cause: /api/reports/data_quality_trend returns just 1 row. Consider filling missing days with zeros for a proper trend line.
Static copy said '9 SIS partners' and '12 reports' — stale post-reseed. Fixed to '10 SIS partners' and '15 reports' in /app/frontend/src/pages/Login.jsx.

action_items: Consider densifying data_quality_trend report to have one row per day in the 14-day window so the dashboard mini-chart renders as a proper trend rather than a single block.
Non-blocking: /api/partners returns 10 plain items but /api/masters/partners returns paginated dict{items,total}. Two shapes for the same resource is slightly inconsistent — align if practical.
critical_code_review_comments: Learned mapping precedence works: SHOPPERS-format xlsx with headers Partner/Location/Style Code/Selling Date/... was auto-detected as SHOPPERS without manual mapping.
target_vs_actual/stock_position/partner_margin all return non-empty rows (9/456/16). CSV+XLSX exports for target_vs_actual return 200 with content.

Dashboard payload correctly includes as_of, kpis.target_wk>0, achievement_pct≈69.7, and weekly array (40 weeks). RBAC still enforced (ops→uploads OK but forbidden to POST masters/stores; mgmt forbidden from uploads; ops forbidden from /api/users).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_api_e2e.py (updated: 10 partners, 15 reports incl. 3 new ones, SHOPPERS upload flow with reject cleanup, aliases + margins + insights + exceptions checks)
seed_data_creation: Uploaded 1 SHOPPERS xlsx (3 rows, style FMBA8713334) via ops account → auto-detected as SHOPPERS → then rejected the batch. Also ran the store-duplicate assertion which may (re)insert TEST_STORE_A in stores master.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green on real data (54/54). Fixture pattern: session-scoped tokens for admin/ops/mgmt. Reports API endpoint is /api/reports/{key} (not /api/reports/run/{key}); export is /api/reports/{key}/export?fmt=csv|xlsx. Masters partners uses paginated {items,total}; plain /api/partners returns a bare list. Batch reject endpoint: POST /api/batches/{id}/reject with {'reason': ...}. Weekly array on /api/dashboard has 40 buckets like 25-W14..26-W32. Do NOT reseed (2min); partners collection non-empty guards seed. When testing upload deduplication, add a random tail to the xlsx bytes on retries to avoid hash collisions from prior runs.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs. Iteration-1 test file used stale codes (SS, 9 partners, 12 reports); updated to real Bata codes without touching product code.
